_comment: Pennyroyal Next fixed-W4 width policy: pass this file as --speculative-adaptive-config.
Keys are batch-size floors and candidate steps are speculative_num_steps; at topk=1 a
width's draft-token count is steps+1, so every concurrency, one request or many, is fixed
at W4 (steps 3). One candidate per tier means the width is a lookup on the batch size and
the acceptance EMA can never move it, so no hysteresis or hold/backoff keys are needed or
honoured here, and the narrowest launch is enough.
Launch for it: --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4. No BS1 W8
decode bucket is ever entered, so the C1 batch never pads up into a wider tier.
